# Test fixtures

`*.lead.wiki`: section 0 (everything before the first heading) of English Wikipedia articles, as stored in the
WikES PostgreSQL-1.0.0 database (enwiki dump of 2023-05-01). Wikipedia text is licensed under
[CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); authors are listed in each article's history on
en.wikipedia.org (Elvis Presley, David Bowie, Alfred Hitchcock, Oprah Winfrey).
